name: Tryg A/S
summary: Tryg A/S, along with its subsidiaries, offers a wide array of insurance products and services tailored for private individuals, corporate clients, and small to medium-sized businesses across Denmark, Norway, and Sweden. Its comprehensive portfolio includes coverage for automobiles, homes, contents, travel, and personal accidents, in addition to policies for pets, health, property, liability, transportation, and group life. These offerings are distributed through a diverse network, leveraging call centers, online platforms, proprietary agents, franchisees, and various organizational partnerships. Established in 1731, Tryg A/S maintains its headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark.
